label: Killed
evidence_rule: heading «Killed», or per-person qualifier states death, or prose states the victim died

label: Disappeared — whereabouts unresolved
evidence_rule: victim never located as of the account's latest report; source uses «forcibly disappeared»/«disappeared»

label: Abducted, later located alive
evidence_rule: abducted, then located alive (rescued/released) — assigned per person

label: Lethal force — victim not struck
evidence_rule: lethal force directed at a victim who was not physically struck, stated at the person (never promoted from a property attack)

label: Gravely injured
evidence_rule: struck by gunfire and survived, or a stated gravity marker (hospitalization / «grave» / life-threatening / reconstructive surgery / wound count)

label: Gravely assaulted
evidence_rule: non-firearm beating with a stated lasting-injury marker (stitches, fracture, surgery, hospitalization, documented multiple contusions)

label: Injured
evidence_rule: struck by gunfire or violence and survived, where the account states the injury as minor / carries no gravity marker

label: Assaulted
evidence_rule: physical assault with no stated lasting-injury marker

label: Threats, harassment, property attack
evidence_rule: threats / harassment / property crime with no physical injury to the person stated

label: Pattern of attacks (container)
evidence_rule: heading-flagged multi-event escalating case; a container requiring a sub-timeline, not one outcome
